bindings.3.2:
bind-key -T brindle-view MouseDown1Pane select-pane -t = \; send-keys -M
bind-key -T brindle-view MouseDown2Pane select-pane -t = \; if-shell -F "#{||:#{pane_in_mode},#{mouse_any_flag}}" "send -M" "paste -p"
bind-key -T brindle-view MouseDrag1Pane if-shell -F "#{||:#{pane_in_mode},#{mouse_any_flag}}" "send -M" "copy-mode -M"
bind-key -T brindle-view WheelUpPane if-shell -F "#{||:#{pane_in_mode},#{mouse_any_flag}}" "send -M" "copy-mode -e"
bind-key -T brindle-view DoubleClick1Pane select-pane -t = \; if-shell -F "#{||:#{pane_in_mode},#{mouse_any_flag}}" "send -M" "copy-mode -H ; send -X select-word ; run -d0.3 ; send -X copy-pipe-and-cancel"
bind-key -T brindle-view TripleClick1Pane select-pane -t = \; if-shell -F "#{||:#{pane_in_mode},#{mouse_any_flag}}" "send -M" "copy-mode -H ; send -X select-line ; run -d0.3 ; send -X copy-pipe-and-cancel"
bind-key -T brindle-view C-M-S-F12 if-shell -F "#{selection_present}" "send-keys -X copy-selection-no-clear"
bind-key -T brindle-view C-M-S-F11 if-shell -F "#{selection_present}" "send-keys -X copy-selection-and-cancel" "send-keys C-c"

check_version: The agents' tmux server is tmux 3.0a, and brindle needs tmux 3.2 or newer to show a session. Update tmux, then reopen the session.
